notice: Synthetic engineering benchmark. Evidence is written for this file and is deliberately simple, non-sensitive and not real clinical guidance. Each case is a draft answer paired with the evidence it cites, so verification is measured independently of retrieval, the sufficiency gate and generation. No clinician reviewed these labels and none of this is evidence about clinical performance.
